pack.title: Starter: company
pack.description: For a company: customers, products, and operations, corporate functions, and data about customers and payments. No research or clinical map.

audiences.label: Leadership
audiences.description: Executives and the people who lead its divisions

audiences.label: Hourly employees
audiences.description: Staff paid by the hour, who record their time

audiences.label: Contractors and temporary staff
audiences.description: People who work for it without being employees

audiences.label: Sales and customer-facing staff
audiences.description: The people who sell to and look after customers

audiences.label: Front-line and operations staff
audiences.description: The people who make, move, or deliver what it sells

audiences.label: Corporate staff
audiences.description: Finance, people, legal, and the other corporate functions

audiences.label: Engineering and IT staff
audiences.description: The people who build and run its products and technology

tiers.label: 1 · Mission critical
tiers.description: Revenue, customers, or safety stop without it

tiers.label: 2 · Business critical
tiers.description: Important work stops within a day without it

tiers.label: 3 · Business operational
tiers.description: Its loss would be felt within days and worked around

tiers.label: 4 · Administrative
tiers.description: Could be done without for weeks with little effect

tiers.label: 5 · Minimal
tiers.description: Could be switched off with almost no effect

data_classes.label: Public
data_classes.description: May be shared with anyone: published results, public web content.

data_classes.label: Internal
data_classes.description: Meant for the organization's own work: plans, procedures, most email.

data_classes.label: Personal information
data_classes.description: About identifiable staff, students, donors, or the public.

data_classes.label: Protected health information
data_classes.description: Health information about identifiable patients, held under health privacy law.

data_classes.label: Payment card data
data_classes.description: Card numbers and related data, held under the card industry's rules.

data_classes.label: Confidential
data_classes.description: Plans, contracts, and trade secrets that would harm the company if disclosed.

data_classes.label: Customer data
data_classes.description: About customers and their accounts, orders, and use of the product.

funding.label: Charged back to a business unit

children.name: Quality
children.description: Testing, defects, and compliance of the product

capabilities.name: Information technology
capabilities.description: The shared technology everyone relies on

children.name: Identity and access
children.description: Accounts, sign-in, and who may do what

children.name: Collaboration and email
children.description: Email, chat, meetings, and shared files

children.name: Data platform and integration
children.description: Moving and joining data between applications

fields.label: Accessibility
fields.help: How well people with disabilities can use it, as last checked.

fields.label: In scope for financial reporting
fields.help: Whether the financial statements rely on it, so its controls are audited.

definition.text: An application is software, or a service built from software, that people name, use for a purpose, and could decide to keep, change, or retire as one thing.
not_examples: A server or a database on its own: record it as a component of what it serves
A report or a module of a larger system: a component of that system
A spreadsheet one person keeps for themselves
A programming language or a platform: a technology
